# Sprint 04: Trust pipeline

**Sequence:** 4
**Timeline:** Phase 2
**Status:** Awaiting Close
> Progress: 7/7 tasks completed · updated 2026-07-19T23:02:46Z
> Status-Note: goal met — gate 8/8 · e2e PASS · human-test 8/8 · trunk consolidated
**Proposed by:** product-manager + convex-planner (lane) + aisdk-planner (lever-2 structured output)

## Overview

The phase-sliced "trust pipeline": the deterministic geometry gate hardened to full (VER-01),
the bounded LLM repair round (VER-02), the three recovery levers (Lever 1 promote, Lever 2
reconstruct, Lever 3 re-route), the cross-provider ride-worthiness classifier (VER-03), the
resumable `--sample` waterfall with a cost circuit-breaker and a REVIEW queue (REC-04 sample,
VER-04), and the founder couch-sample gate (VER-05) — all on real Google + LLM APIs, closing on
one couch human gate so the full `--all` batch (Sprint 05) can be unlocked.

The gate is the single source of truth for ALL geometry admission (specified in UC-VER-01,
invoked by every lever — never re-implemented per lever): ratio = routed / claimed within
0.6–1.6; ≥2 anchors each within 150 mi of the route centroid; reject degenerate (≤4 points or
<1 point/mi); applied to all geometry going forward including a pre-existing-rows sweep; ratio
skipped in favor of the degenerate + region checks when the claimed length is quarantined
(null/outlier) so the routed length becomes the stored truth.

The three levers run in order (promote → reconstruct → re-route) until one produces a
gate-passing geometry, recording provenance (`scraped_promoted` / `ai_reconstructed` /
`name_routed`): Lever 1 promotes validated in-row scraped polylines at $0 (no LLM/geocode);
Lever 2 reconstructs from turn-by-turn descriptions via LLM-extracted ordered anchors →
region-biased geocode → route-through-waypoints → gate, with structured outputs through the
Mastra model layer established in Sprint 02; Lever 3 re-routes from endpoint/road-name
structure deterministically (no LLM). Gate-failing reconstructions get a bounded repair (≤2
attempts, geocode log + measured lengths fed back, keep the better of the two by ratio
distance), then land in the REVIEW queue. The ride-worthiness classifier runs across the whole
catalog on a DIFFERENT provider than anchor extraction, recording a `ride`/`marginal`/
`not_a_ride` verdict as stored evidence (never a transient read-time decision; `not_a_ride`
withholds rider-ready; `marginal` never auto-retires).

The `--sample` waterfall is resumable (skip already-PASSed on restart), cost-capped
(`--max-cost` circuit-breaker + rate-limit/backoff, ~$0.07/reconstructed route), and ends every
processed route in exactly one terminal state. The couch-sample gate (VER-05) assembles a ~25
stratified sample spanning all three provenance types, renders each recovered line on a map
with its provenance + measured-vs-claimed lengths, and the founder records a per-route verdict
(true / off / wrong) and an overall pass/fail — a single `wrong` (fabricated-but-passing line)
forces fail, and the driver refuses `--all` until the couch verdict is recorded as pass. That
couch PASS is the deterministic unlock for the full `--all` batch in Sprint 05.

**Built on the spikes:** the gate module + reconstruct-one path + persist/recompute seam are the
Sprint 01 reference implementations (hardened to full here, not rebuilt); the Mastra model layer
+ z.ai structured-output proof are the Sprint 02 foundation the Lever 2 anchors + repair round
extractions resolve through; the cleaned claimed lengths from Sprint 03 are what the ratio gate
calibrates against. Enrichment-PRD `06-external-dependencies.md` re-ratification (Sprint 02,
T-AGT-024) is the cross-PRD prerequisite already discharged before this sprint's structured
outputs land.

## Human Testing Gate

**Gate:** The Founder-Operator reviews the ~25 rendered couch-sample lines and records the passing verdict that unlocks the full batch.

### Human Test Deliverable

A founder-reviewed ~25-route couch sample, stratified across all three provenance types
(`scraped_promoted` / `ai_reconstructed` / `name_routed`) and a range of reconstruction
difficulty, each recovered line rendered as a map PNG alongside its provenance and measured-vs-
claimed lengths. The founder records a per-route verdict (`true` / `off` / `wrong`) and an
overall pass/fail — a single `wrong` (a fabricated-but-gate-passing line) forces the verdict
red, and the batch driver refuses `--all` until the couch verdict is recorded as pass. The
founder also dispositions three REVIEW-queue items (approve / retry / retire) so the fail-closed
adjudication path is exercised on real failures. The lever waterfall runs as a `--sample` batch
on real Google Geocoding/Routes + the real geometry/orchestrator LLM tiers; every processed route
ends in exactly one terminal state.

### Test Steps

1. Run the lever waterfall as a `--sample` batch on real Google + LLM APIs.
2. Confirm each processed route ends in exactly one terminal state.
3. Open the ~25-route couch sample rendered as map PNGs.
4. Record `true`, `off`, or `wrong` for each sampled route.
5. Record an overall pass or fail verdict.
6. Confirm a single `wrong` verdict forces the gate red.
7. Disposition three REVIEW-queue items: approve, retry, retire.
8. Confirm the driver refuses `--all` until the couch verdict passes.

withholds rider-ready; `marginal` never auto-retires).

The `--sample` waterfall is resumable (skip already-PASSed on restart), cost-capped
(`--max-cost` circuit-breaker + rate-limit/backoff, ~$0.07/reconstructed route), and ends every
processed route in exactly one terminal state. The couch-sample gate (VER-05) assembles a ~25
stratified sample spanning all three provenance types, renders each recovered line on a map
with its provenance + measured-vs-claimed lengths, and the founder records a per-route verdict
(true / off / wrong) and an overall pass/fail — a single `wrong` (fabricated-but-passing line)
forces fail, and the driver refuses `--all` until the couch verdict is recorded as pass. That
couch PASS is the deterministic unlock for the full `--all` batch in Sprint 05.

**Built on the spikes:** the gate module + reconstruct-one path + persist/recompute seam are the
Sprint 01 reference implementations (hardened to full here, not rebuilt); the Mastra model layer
+ z.ai structured-output proof are the Sprint 02 foundation the Lever 2 anchors + repair round
extractions resolve through; the cleaned claimed lengths from Sprint 03 are what the ratio gate
calibrates against. Enrichment-PRD `06-external-dependencies.md` re-ratification (Sprint 02,
T-AGT-024) is the cross-PRD prerequisite already discharged before this sprint's structured
outputs land.

## Human Testing Gate

**Gate:** The Founder-Operator reviews the ~25 rendered couch-sample lines and records the passing verdict that unlocks the full batch.

### Human Test Deliverable

A founder-reviewed ~25-route couch sample, stratified across all three provenance types
(`scraped_promoted` / `ai_reconstructed` / `name_routed`) and a range of reconstruction
difficulty, each recovered line rendered as a map PNG alongside its provenance and measured-vs-
claimed lengths. The founder records a per-route verdict (`true` / `off` / `wrong`) and an
overall pass/fail — a single `wrong` (a fabricated-but-gate-passing line) forces the verdict
red, and the batch driver refuses `--all` until the couch verdict is recorded as pass. The
founder also dispositions three REVIEW-queue items (approve / retry / retire) so the fail-closed
adjudication path is exercised on real failures. The lever waterfall runs as a `--sample` batch
on real Google Geocoding/Routes + the real geometry/orchestrator LLM tiers; every processed route
ends in exactly one terminal state.

### Test Steps

1. Run the lever waterfall as a `--sample` batch on real Google + LLM APIs.
2. Confirm each processed route ends in exactly one terminal state.
3. Open the ~25-route couch sample rendered as map PNGs.
4. Record `true`, `off`, or `wrong` for each sampled route.
5. Record an overall pass or fail verdict.
6. Confirm a single `wrong` verdict forces the gate red.
7. Disposition three REVIEW-queue items: approve, retry, retire.
8. Confirm the driver refuses `--all` until the couch verdict passes.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /Users/inference1/Projects/LaneShadow-RN
ID='{"subject":"s4-human-gate","issuer":"https://laneshadow.test"}'
OUT=.tmp/sprint-04-trust-pipeline/couch-export
mkdir -p "$OUT"
npx convex run couchSampleAssembler:seedCouchFixtures '{}' --identity "$ID" | tee /tmp/s4-seed-couch.json
npx convex run couchSampleAssembler:assembleCouchSample '{"targetSize":25}' --identity "$ID" | tee /tmp/s4-sample.json
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
d=json.load(open('/tmp/s4-sample.json'))
assert 20 <= len(d.get('routes',[])) <= 30, len(d.get('routes',[]))
print('sampleId', d['sampleId'], 'routes', len(d['routes']))
open('/tmp/s4-sample-id.txt','w').write(d['sampleId'])
PY
SID=$(cat /tmp/s4-sample-id.txt)
npx convex run couchSampleExport:exportCouchSample "{\"sampleId\":\"$SID\"}" --identity "$ID" | tee /tmp/s4-export.json >/dev/null
# export can be large; rewrite tee carefully
npx convex run couchSampleExport:exportCouchSample "{\"sampleId\":\"$SID\"}" --identity "$ID" > /tmp/s4-export.json
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,base64
from pathlib import Path
out=Path('.tmp/sprint-04-trust-pipeline/couch-export')
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
for p in out.glob('*.png'):
    p.unlink()
d=json.load(open('/tmp/s4-export.json'))
assert d['size']>=20, d['size']
for r in d['routes']:
    p=out/f"{r['routeId'].replace(':','_')}.png"
    p.write_bytes(base64.b64decode(r['pngBase64']))
pngs=list(out.glob('*.png'))
assert len(pngs)>=20, len(pngs)
# unique sizes check (non-blank maps)
sizes=sorted({p.stat().st_size for p in pngs})
assert len(sizes)>=1 and min(sizes)>100
print(json.dumps({'ok':True,'sampleId':d['sampleId'],'pngs':len(pngs),'size':d['size'],'unique_byte_sizes':len(sizes)}))
PY

    98	export function determineGateVerdict(args: {
    99	  ratio: number | undefined | null
   100	  pointCount: number
   101	  routedMiles: number
   102	  anchorCount: number
   103	  quarantine?: boolean
   104	}): GateVerdict {
   105	  const ratio = normalizeRatio(args.ratio)
   106	
   107	  if (args.anchorCount < 2) {
   108	    return { verdict: 'review', failedCondition: 'anchors', ratio, ratioSkipped: false }
   109	  }
   110	
   111	  // Quarantine must NEVER short-circuit the degenerate check.
   112	  if (isDegenerate({ pointCount: args.pointCount, routedMiles: args.routedMiles })) {
   113	    return { verdict: 'review', failedCondition: 'degenerate', ratio, ratioSkipped: false }
   114	  }
   115	
   116	  // AC-4: Quarantine flag skips the ratio check — routed length becomes truth.
   117	  // The real computed ratio is still recorded so the skip stays observable.
   118	  if (args.quarantine) {
   119	    return { verdict: 'pass', ratio, ratioSkipped: true }
   120	  }
   121	
   122	  const ratioResult = evaluateRatioBoundary(args.ratio)
   123	  if (!ratioResult.passes) {
   124	    return { verdict: 'review', failedCondition: 'ratio', ratio, ratioSkipped: false }
   125	  }
   126	
   127	  return { verdict: 'pass', ratio, ratioSkipped: false }

    98	export function determineGateVerdict(args: {
    99	  ratio: number | undefined | null
   100	  pointCount: number
   101	  routedMiles: number
   102	  anchorCount: number
   103	  quarantine?: boolean
   104	}): GateVerdict {
   105	  const ratio = normalizeRatio(args.ratio)
   106	
   107	  if (args.anchorCount < 2) {
   108	    return { verdict: 'review', failedCondition: 'anchors', ratio, ratioSkipped: false }
   109	  }
   110	
   111	  // Quarantine must NEVER short-circuit the degenerate check.
   112	  if (isDegenerate({ pointCount: args.pointCount, routedMiles: args.routedMiles })) {
   113	    return { verdict: 'review', failedCondition: 'degenerate', ratio, ratioSkipped: false }
   114	  }
   115	
   116	  // AC-4: Quarantine flag skips the ratio check — routed length becomes truth.
   117	  // The real computed ratio is still recorded so the skip stays observable.
   118	  if (args.quarantine) {
   119	    return { verdict: 'pass', ratio, ratioSkipped: true }
   120	  }
   121	
   122	  const ratioResult = evaluateRatioBoundary(args.ratio)
   123	  if (!ratioResult.passes) {
   124	    return { verdict: 'review', failedCondition: 'ratio', ratio, ratioSkipped: false }
   125	  }
   126

   445	    maxCost: v.optional(v.number()),
   446	    costPerReconstruct: v.optional(v.number()),
   447	    maxRetries: v.optional(v.number()),
   448	    /** When set, Lever 2 uses production fixed-geometry reconstruct (deterministic). */
   449	    lever2FixedGeometry: v.optional(lever2FixedGeometryValidator),
   450	    /**
   451	     * Test seam: force Lever 2 to throw rate-limit errors N times before succeeding
   452	     * (or exhausting retries). Does not call external APIs.
   453	     */
   454	    simulateRateLimitFailures: v.optional(v.number()),
   455	    /** When true, sleep is a no-op so backoff tests finish instantly. */
   456	    skipSleep: v.optional(v.boolean()),
   457	  },
   458	  handler: async (ctx, args): Promise<WaterfallReport> => {
   459	    await requireIdentity(ctx)
   460	
   461	    const maxCost = args.maxCost ?? null
   462	    const costPer = args.costPerReconstruct ?? COST_PER_RECONSTRUCT_USD
   463	    const maxRetries = args.maxRetries ?? DEFAULT_MAX_RETRIES
   464	    const backoffScheduleSeconds = computeBackoffDelaysSeconds(maxRetries)
   465	    const sleep = args.skipSleep
   466	      ? async () => {
   467	          /* no-op for tests */
   468	        }
   469	      : undefined
   470	    let remainingRateLimitSim = args.simulateRateLimitFailures ?? 0
   471	
   472	    let totalCostUsd = 0
   473	    let batchStopReason: WaterfallReport['batchStopReason'] = 'completed'
   474	    let costExceededMessage: string | null = null
   475	
   476	    const routes: RouteWaterfallResult[] = []
   477	    const perLeverCounts = { lever1: 0, lever2: 0, lever3: 0 }
   478	    const perStateCounts = {
   479	      recovered: 0,
   480	      queued: 0,
   481	      retirement_eligible: 0,
   482	      skipped: 0,
   483	    }
   484	
   485	    for (const routeId of args.routeIds) {
   486	      // Cost circuit-breaker: stop before starting a route that would need L2
   487	      // when the next reconstruct would exceed budget. Checked again before L2.
   488	
   489	      const routeMeta = await ctx.runQuery(api.curatedGeometryReconstruct.getRouteForReading, {
   490	        routeId,
   491	      })
   492	
   493	      // Resume: skip already-PASSed
   494	      if (routeMeta?.geometryStatus === 'generated') {
   495	        const skipped: RouteWaterfallResult = {
   496	          routeId,
   497	          terminalState: 'recovered',
   498	          skipped: true,
   499	          reprocessed: false,
   500	          leversRun: [],
   501	          provenance: undefined,
   502	          costUsd: 0,
   503	        }
   504	        routes.push(skipped)
   505	        perStateCounts.skipped += 1
   506	        continue
   507	      }
   508	
   509	      const leversRun: number[] = []
   510	      let lever1Failed = false
   511	      let lever2Failed = false
   512	      let costUsd = 0
   513	      let terminalState: TerminalState = 'retirement_eligible'
   514	      let provenance: RouteWaterfallResult['provenance']
   515	      let failedCondition: string | null | undefined
   516	      let bestCandidateGeometry: string | null = null
   517	
   518	      // ----- Lever 1: promote -----
   519	      leversRun.push(1)
   520	      perLeverCounts.lever1 += 1
   521	      const l1Wrapped = await withExponentialBackoff(
   522	        async () => {
   523	          return ctx.runAction(api.curatedGeometryReconstruct.promoteForRoute, { routeId })
   524	        },
   525	        { maxRetries, sleep },
   526	      )
   527	      const l1 = l1Wrapped.result as {
   528	        disposition: string
   529	        provenance?: string
   530	        failedCondition?: string
   531	        geometry?: string
   532	      }
   533	
   534	      if (l1.disposition === 'generated') {
   535	        terminalState = 'recovered'
   536	        provenance = 'scraped_promoted'
   537	        const result: RouteWaterfallResult = {
   538	          routeId,
   539	          terminalState,
   540	          skipped: false,
   541	          reprocessed: false,
   542	          leversRun,
   543	          provenance,
   544	          costUsd: 0,
   545	        }
   546	        routes.push(result)
   547	        perStateCounts.recovered += 1
   548	        await recordTerminalArtifact(ctx, result)
   549	        continue
   550	      }
   551	      lever1Failed = true
   552	      if (l1.geometry) bestCandidateGeometry = l1.geometry
   553	
   554	      // ----- Cost check before Lever 2 -----
   555	      if (maxCost != null && totalCostUsd + costPer > maxCost) {
   556	        batchStopReason = 'cost_exceeded'
   557	        costExceededMessage = `cost_exceeded: totalCost $${totalCostUsd.toFixed(2)} + next $${costPer.toFixed(2)} would exceed maxCost $${maxCost.toFixed(2)}`
   558	        // Stop the batch; this route was not fully processed (L2 not attempted).
   559	        break
   560	      }
   561	
   562	      // ----- Lever 2: reconstruct -----
   563	      leversRun.push(2)
   564	      perLeverCounts.lever2 += 1
   565	
   566	      try {
   567	        if (remainingRateLimitSim > 0) {
   568	          // Pure rate-limit exercise path (AC-4) — only once per batch
   569	          let failuresLeft = remainingRateLimitSim
   570	          remainingRateLimitSim = 0
   571	          await withExponentialBackoff(
   572	            async () => {
   573	              if (failuresLeft > 0) {
   574	                failuresLeft -= 1
   575	                const err = new Error('Google API 429 rate limit') as RateLimitError
   576	                err.status = 429
   577	                err.isRateLimit = true
   578	                throw err
   579	              }
   580	              return { ok: true }
   581	            },
   582	            { maxRetries, sleep },
   583	          )
   584	        }
   585	
   586	        const l2Wrapped = await withExponentialBackoff(
   587	          async () => {
   588	            if (args.lever2FixedGeometry) {
   589	              return ctx.runAction(
   590	                api.curatedGeometryReconstruct.reconstructForRouteWithFixedGeometry,
   591	                {
   592	                  routeId,
   593	                  routedMiles: args.lever2FixedGeometry.routedMiles,
   594	                  pointCount: args.lever2FixedGeometry.pointCount,
   595	                  anchorCount: args.lever2FixedGeometry.anchorCount,
   596	                  claimedMiles: args.lever2FixedGeometry.claimedMiles,
   597	                },
   598	              )
   599	            }
   600	            return ctx.runAction(api.curatedGeometryReconstruct.reconstructForRoute, {
   601	              routeId,
   602	            })
   603	          },
   604	          { maxRetries, sleep },
   605	        )
   606	        costUsd += costPer
   607	        totalCostUsd += costPer
   608	
   609	        const l2 = l2Wrapped.result as {
   610	          verdict: string
   611	          provenance?: string
   612	          failedCondition?: string
   613	          geometry?: string
   614	        }
   615	
   616	        if (l2.geometry) bestCandidateGeometry = l2.geometry
   617	
   618	        if (l2.verdict === 'pass') {
   619	          terminalState = 'recovered'
   620	          provenance = 'ai_reconstructed'
   621	          const result: RouteWaterfallResult = {
   622	            routeId,
   623	            terminalState,
   624	            skipped: false,
   625	            reprocessed: false,
   626	            leversRun,
   627	            provenance,
   628	            lever1Failed,
   629	            costUsd,
   630	          }
   631	          routes.push(result)
   632	          perStateCounts.recovered += 1
   633	          await recordTerminalArtifact(ctx, result)
   634	          continue
   635	        }
   636	        lever2Failed = true
   637	        failedCondition = l2.failedCondition ?? 'ratio'
   638	      } catch (err) {
   639	        lever2Failed = true
   640	        failedCondition = isRateLimitError(err) ? 'rate_limit_exhausted' : 'anchors'
   641	      }
   642	
   643	      // ----- Lever 3: re-route -----
   644	      leversRun.push(3)
   645	      perLeverCounts.lever3 += 1
   646	
   647	      try {
   648	        const l3Wrapped = await withExponentialBackoff(
   649	          async () => {
   650	            return ctx.runAction(api.curatedGeometryReconstruct.rerouteForRoute, { routeId })
   651	          },
   652	          { maxRetries, sleep },
   653	        )
   654	        const l3 = l3Wrapped.result as {
   655	          disposition: string
   656	          provenance?: string
   657	          failedCondition?: string
   658	          geometry?: string
   659	        }
   660	
   661	        if (l3.geometry) bestCandidateGeometry = l3.geometry
   662	
   663	        if (l3.disposition === 'generated') {
   664	          terminalState = 'recovered'
   665	          provenance = 'name_routed'
   666	          const result: RouteWaterfallResult = {
   667	            routeId,
   668	            terminalState,
   669	            skipped: false,
   670	            reprocessed: false,
   671	            leversRun,
   672	            provenance,
   673	            lever1Failed,
   674	            lever2Failed,
   675	            costUsd,
   676	          }
   677	          routes.push(result)
   678	          perStateCounts.recovered += 1
   679	          await recordTerminalArtifact(ctx, result)
   680	          continue
   681	        }
   682	
   683	        // REVIEW queue (terminal) — keep best candidate geometry across levers
   684	        terminalState = 'queued'
   685	        failedCondition = l3.failedCondition ?? failedCondition ?? 'anchors'
   686	        const result: RouteWaterfallResult = {
   687	          routeId,
   688	          terminalState,
   689	          skipped: false,
   690	          reprocessed: false,
   691	          leversRun,
   692	          lever1Failed,
   693	          lever2Failed,
   694	          failedCondition,
   695	          costUsd,
   696	        }
   697	        routes.push(result)
   698	        perStateCounts.queued += 1
   699	        await recordTerminalArtifact(ctx, result)
   700	        await recordReviewArtifact(ctx, routeId, failedCondition, bestCandidateGeometry)
   701	      } catch {
   702	        terminalState = 'retirement_eligible'
   703	        const result: RouteWaterfallResult = {
   704	          routeId,
   705	          terminalState,
   706	          skipped: false,
   707	          reprocessed: false,
   708	          leversRun,
   709	          lever1Failed,
   710	          lever2Failed,
   711	          failedCondition: failedCondition ?? 'anchors',
   712	          costUsd,
   713	        }
   714	        routes.push(result)
   715	        perStateCounts.retirement_eligible += 1
   716	        await recordTerminalArtifact(ctx, result)
   717	        if (bestCandidateGeometry) {
   718	          await recordReviewArtifact(ctx, routeId, failedCondition, bestCandidateGeometry)
   719	        }
   720	      }

   453	export const listRecoveredCandidates = query({
   454	  args: {
   455	    routeIdPrefix: v.optional(v.string()),
   456	    /** When true (default), look up known couch fixture routeIds by index so
   457	     * they are not lost among a large generated catalog. */
   458	    preferFixtures: v.optional(v.boolean()),
   459	    limit: v.optional(v.number()),
   460	  },
   461	  handler: async (ctx, { routeIdPrefix, preferFixtures, limit }) => {
   462	    await requireIdentity(ctx)
   463	    const take = Math.min(limit ?? 200, 400)
   464	    const candidates: CouchSampleRoute[] = []
   465	    const seen = new Set<string>()
   466	
   467	    // Prefer explicit fixture lookups (index by_routeId) — reliable for tests.
   468	    if (preferFixtures !== false) {
   469	      for (const spec of buildSeedSpecs()) {
   470	        if (routeIdPrefix && !spec.routeId.startsWith(routeIdPrefix)) {
   471	          const isPrd =
   472	            spec.routeId.startsWith('test:scraped-') ||
   473	            spec.routeId.startsWith('test:ai-recon-') ||
   474	            spec.routeId.startsWith('test:name-routed-')
   475	          if (!isPrd) continue
   476	        }
   477	        const row = await ctx.db
   478	          .query('curated_routes')
   479	          .withIndex('by_routeId', (q) => q.eq('routeId', spec.routeId))
   480	          .first()
   481	        if (!row || row.geometryStatus !== 'generated') continue
   482	        const c = await toCandidate(ctx, row)
   483	        if (c && !seen.has(c.routeId)) {
   484	          seen.add(c.routeId)
   485	          candidates.push(c)
   486	        }
   487	      }
   488	    }
   489	
   490	    // Supplement from generated index when more catalog routes are wanted
   491	    if (candidates.length < take) {
   492	      const rows = await ctx.db
   493	        .query('curated_routes')
   494	        .withIndex('by_geometry_status', (q) => q.eq('geometryStatus', 'generated'))
   495	        .take(take)
   496	      for (const row of rows) {
   497	        if (seen.has(row.routeId)) continue
   498	        if (routeIdPrefix && !row.routeId.startsWith(routeIdPrefix)) continue
   499	        const c = await toCandidate(ctx, row)
   500	        if (c) {
   501	          seen.add(c.routeId)
   502	          candidates.push(c)
   503	        }
   504	      }
   505	    }
   506	
   507	    return { candidates, count: candidates.length }
   508	  },
   509	})

   511	export const getCouchSample = query({
   512	  args: { sampleId: v.string() },
   513	  handler: async (ctx, { sampleId }) => {
   514	    await requireIdentity(ctx)

   426	  const geom = await ctx.db
   427	    .query('curated_route_geometry')
   428	    .withIndex('by_routeId', (q: any) => q.eq('routeId', row.routeId))
   429	    .first()

   432	    row.geometryProvenance ??

   434	  if (!provenance || !PROVENANCES.includes(provenance)) return null
   435	
   436	  const anchorCount = geom?.verification?.anchorCount ?? 2

   438	  const routedMiles = geom?.verification?.routedMiles ?? row.lengthMiles ?? 0
   439	  const descriptionLength = (row.summary ?? row.oneLiner ?? '').length
   440	  const difficulty = classifyDifficulty(anchorCount, descriptionLength)
   441	
   442	  return {

   453	export const listRecoveredCandidates = query({
   454	  args: {
   455	    routeIdPrefix: v.optional(v.string()),
   456	    /** When true (default), look up known couch fixture routeIds by index so
   457	     * they are not lost among a large generated catalog. */
   458	    preferFixtures: v.optional(v.boolean()),
   459	    limit: v.optional(v.number()),
   460	  },
   461	  handler: async (ctx, { routeIdPrefix, preferFixtures, limit }) => {
   462	    await requireIdentity(ctx)
   463	    const take = Math.min(limit ?? 200, 400)
   464	    const candidates: CouchSampleRoute[] = []
   465	    const seen = new Set<string>()
   466	
   467	    // Prefer explicit fixture lookups (index by_routeId) — reliable for tests.
   468	    if (preferFixtures !== false) {
   469	      for (const spec of buildSeedSpecs()) {
   470	        if (routeIdPrefix && !spec.routeId.startsWith(routeIdPrefix)) {
   471	          const isPrd =
   472	            spec.routeId.startsWith('test:scraped-') ||
   473	            spec.routeId.startsWith('test:ai-recon-') ||
   474	            spec.routeId.startsWith('test:name-routed-')
   475	          if (!isPrd) continue
   476	        }
   477	        const row = await ctx.db
   478	          .query('curated_routes')
   479	          .withIndex('by_routeId', (q) => q.eq('routeId', spec.routeId))
   480	          .first()
   481	        if (!row || row.geometryStatus !== 'generated') continue
   482	        const c = await toCandidate(ctx, row)
   483	        if (c && !seen.has(c.routeId)) {
   484	          seen.add(c.routeId)
   485	          candidates.push(c)
   486	        }
   487	      }
   488	    }
   489	
   490	    // Supplement from generated index when more catalog routes are wanted
   491	    if (candidates.length < take) {
   492	      const rows = await ctx.db
   493	        .query('curated_routes')
   494	        .withIndex('by_geometry_status', (q) => q.eq('geometryStatus', 'generated'))
   495	        .take(take)
   496	      for (const row of rows) {
   497	        if (seen.has(row.routeId)) continue
   498	        if (routeIdPrefix && !row.routeId.startsWith(routeIdPrefix)) continue
   499	        const c = await toCandidate(ctx, row)
   500	        if (c) {
   501	          seen.add(c.routeId)
   502	          candidates.push(c)
   503	        }
   504	      }
   505	    }
   506	
   507	    return { candidates, count: candidates.length }
   508	  },
   509	})

## AC coverage verdicts
- **S4-T1:** Partial — canonical gate does not validate anchor region.
- **S4-T2/T3:** Partial — levers call the region-incomplete canonical gate.
- **S4-T4:** Not satisfied — “catalog” classification is a caller-provided subset; empty input classifies zero routes.
- **S4-T5:** Not satisfied — terminal-state and cost accounting claims are unsafe.
- **S4-T6:** Not satisfied — arbitrary/counterfeit couch verdicts can unlock `--all`.
- **S4-T7:** Not attested — scripts seed fixtures and programmatically submit all-`true`; no human inspection evidence.

## Findings
- **CRITICAL (high): Couch PASS is forgeable and not bound to a real reviewed sample.** `recordCouchVerdict` never loads/validates `sampleId`, membership, uniqueness, route count, or rendered snapshot; `couchGateStatus` unlocks on any latest pass. Evidence: `convex/couchVerdict.ts:51-101,128-153,323-345`. **Fix:** require immutable exported sample manifest/hash, exact unique membership and all required decisions before allowing PASS.

- **HIGH (high): Any authenticated identity can approve/retry/retire routes or unlock batch processing.** `requireIdentity` only checks identity existence; operational mutations rely solely on it. Evidence: `convex/guards.ts:15-28`; `convex/reviewQueue.ts:236-239,317-320`; `convex/couchVerdict.ts:57-58,131,329`. **Fix:** enforce founder/operator role or ownership authorization for all REVIEW/couch mutations and actions.

- **HIGH (high): REVIEW approval fabricates a passing verification and sets `riderReady=true` without rerunning the gate.** Defaults invent anchors, point count, ratio, and provenance. Evidence: `convex/reviewQueue.ts:251-269,287-292`. **Fix:** decode/re-measure/re-run canonical gate; retain review status and riderReady false when it fails.

- **HIGH (high): The “canonical” geometry gate does not enforce the required in-region anchors for new geometry.** It accepts only `anchorCount`; distance validation exists only in the legacy sweep helper. Evidence: `convex/curatedGeometryGate.ts:98-127` versus `138-152`. **Fix:** pass anchors/centroid (or in-region count) into `determineGateVerdict` and use it from every lever.

- **HIGH (high): `classifyCatalog()` does not enumerate the catalog.** Absent `routeIds`, it returns successful zero work, contradicting T4 AC-1. Evidence: `convex/actions/rideWorthinessClassifier.ts:255-279`. **Fix:** implement bounded/paginated catalog enumeration with checkpoint/completion records.

- **HIGH (high): Waterfall terminal states conflict and cost accounting undercounts real failed/retried provider calls.** A Lever-3 exception records a `retirement_eligible` terminal artifact and, if a candidate exists, a separate `queued` REVIEW artifact for the same route. L2 cost is charged only after its wrapped call returns, excluding failed/retried API attempts. Evidence: `convex/waterfallOrchestrator.ts:586-607,695-718,759-785`. **Fix:** choose one durable terminal state; charge/reserve each billable L2 attempt before invocation and reconcile actual costs.

- **HIGH (high): Gate/human-test claims are test theatre.** Step 1 injects `lever2FixedGeometry`; Step 2 only asserts each returned row has a nonempty string; Step 3 seeds fixtures and checks PNG byte size; Step 4 submits `true` for every route programmatically. Evidence: `.gate-evidence/2026-07-19T22:59:46Z/scripts/step1.sh:5-11`, `step2.sh:9-16`, `step3.sh:7-37`, `step4.sh:7-18`. This conflicts with the asserted verified/human PASS: `GATE-RESULTS.md:3-9,15-29`. **Fix:** replace with authenticated founder review of a persisted real-route export manifest, individual recorded decisions/notes, and independent verification.

### Human-gate precheck
**Failed / not attested.** The gate runner explicitly had no UI driver (`GATE-RESULTS.md:5-6`) and its scripts do not establish that a human inspected real catalog maps. The current PASS must not unlock Sprint 05.
